positions.name: PerformedAdoptionDecision
positions.frame: Is the Zypherion adoption being settled as a ratified fact with a committed timeline, or offered as an open claim awaiting argument?
positions.why: src-1's 'We are adopting Zypherion' declares the decision as performed fact, src-3 pins a committed start date rather than a proposed one, and src-4's bulleted recap re-ratifies both in compressed reference form — all three enact settling-as-fact rather than arguing-for. src-2's comparative performance figure is the justification offered in support, but stands as a defendable claim rather than the ratification act itself, so it is not grouped here even though it shares subject matter.
